const cfg=$('Select Frame.io Account').first().json;const usedRaw=$('List Weekly Story Frames').first().json;const responses=$('List Nested Approved Story Photos').all().map(i=>i.json);const list=x=>Array.isArray(x)?x:(x.data??x.items??x.children??x.records??[]);const norm=x=>String(x??'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const tokens=x=>new Set(norm(x).split(' ').filter(w=>w.length>2));const assets=responses.flatMap(list);const photos=assets.filter(x=>{const type=String(x.type??x.data?.type??'').toLowerCase();const media=String(x.media_type_name??x.media_type??x.data?.media_type_name??x.data?.media_type??'').toLowerCase();return (type==='file'||!type)&&(media.startsWith('image')||/\.(png|jpe?g|webp|heic)$/i.test(String(x.name??x.data?.name??'')));}).map(x=>{const id=x.id??x.data?.id??'';const stable=x.view_url??x.data?.view_url??(id?'https://next.frame.io/project/'+cfg.frameProjectId+'/'+id:'');return {id,name:String(x.name??x.data?.name??'Approved photo'),url:stable,updated:String(x.updated_at??x.created_at??'')};}).filter(x=>x.id&&x.url).filter((x,i,a)=>a.findIndex(y=>y.id===x.id)===i);const start=cfg.weekStart+'T00:00:00';const end=cfg.weekEnd+'T23:59:59';const used=new Set(list(usedRaw).filter(r=>{const at=String(r.fields?.['Scheduled At']??'');return at>=start&&at<=end;}).map(r=>String(r.fields?.['Asset Source URL']??'')).filter(Boolean));const available=photos.filter(p=>!used.has(p.url));if(available.length<cfg.frames.length)throw new Error('Only '+available.length+' unused approved Frame.io photos remain for '+cfg.weekStart+' through '+cfg.weekEnd+'. Add photos or review the week before generating this sequence.');const chosen=new Set();const score=(photo,frame)=>{const wanted=tokens([frame.visualPrompt,frame.copy,frame.role].join(' '));const have=tokens(photo.name);let n=0;for(const word of wanted)if(have.has(word))n+=10;return n;};const startAt=new Date(cfg.date+'T09:00:00');return cfg.frames.map((frame,index)=>{const candidates=available.filter(p=>!chosen.has(p.id)).sort((a,b)=>score(b,frame)-score(a,frame)||b.updated.localeCompare(a.updated)||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));const photo=candidates[0];chosen.add(photo.id);const at=new Date(startAt);at.setHours(9+index*2,index%2?30:0,0,0);const frameNumber=index+1;const role=String(frame.role??(index===0?'Hook / Poll':index===cfg.frames.length-1?'CTA':'Value'));const copy=String(frame.copy??'');const interactiveElement=String(frame.interactiveElement??'None');const cta=String(frame.cta??'');const scheduledAt=at.toISOString();const airtableBody={typecast:true,records:[{fields:{'Story Frame':cfg.sequenceTitle+' · Frame '+frameNumber,'Story Sequence':[cfg.sequenceId],'Parent Content':[cfg.recordId],'Frame Number':frameNumber,'Frame Role':role,'Frame Copy':copy,'Asset Source URL':photo.url,'Interactive Element':interactiveElement,'CTA / Link':cta,'Scheduled At':scheduledAt,'Status':'Draft'}}]};return {json:{...cfg,frames:undefined,frameNumber,role,copy,interactiveElement,cta,visualPrompt:String(frame.visualPrompt??''),scheduledAt,photoName:photo.name,photoUrl:photo.url,airtableBody}};});
